evals.name: fasting-pl-cs
evals.prompt: Порівняй зростання інтересу до інтервального голодування в польськомовній та чеськомовній Wikipedia за останні два роки.
evals.expected_output: A comparison of pl and cs over 24 months. Polish Wikipedia has no article on intermittent fasting, so the answer reports that as a finding (or clearly labels a proxy article) instead of silently using an unrelated article. Czech numbers come from the script, with the trust level and at least one limitation.
assertions: Ran scripts/analyze.ts with --langs containing pl and cs and a 24-month period
States that Polish Wikipedia has no article on intermittent fasting, or explicitly labels any Polish article used as a proxy
Gives the Czech growth (relative or raw YoY) with a number that appears in analysis.json
States the trust level for the Czech series
Mentions at least one limitation: views ≠ willingness to pay, or the edition-wide traffic decline
Every number in the answer is found by scripts/check_claims.ts (no invented numbers)

evals.name: astronomy-uk-trust

assertions: Uses more than one astronomy-related article, or explicitly says a single article is a narrow proxy for a course
Gives a direction for uk with a number that appears in analysis.json
Answers the trust question with a trust label and at least one concrete reason (spikes/September, bots, edition-wide decline, low volume)
Separates the topic's own trend from the whole Ukrainian Wikipedia decline (relative vs raw, or mentions editionGrowth)
Recommends a validation step beyond Wikipedia (landing page, ads test, search volumes, user interviews)
Every number in the answer is found by scripts/check_claims.ts (no invented numbers)

evals.name: english-learning-report
evals.prompt: Ми створюємо застосунок для вивчення мов. Порівняй інтерес до вивчення англійської у німецькій, французькій, іспанській, польській і турецькій Wikipedia та підготуй короткий звіт: які аудиторії варто дослідити наступними й чому?
evals.expected_output: A one-page PDF produced by scripts/report.ts with the agent's own verdict and findings, plus a chat answer that recommends 2–3 audiences to research next with data-based reasons, explains which article is the proxy for 'learning English', and states limitations.
assertions: Ran scripts/report.ts and its final output has "ok": true and "pages": 1
Passed its own --verdict and --findings (not the auto-generated draft)

Says which article was used as the proxy for 'learning English' and what that proxy measures
Mentions at least one limitation or assumption
report.ts output has an empty numbers.unverified list
Verdict labels in the answer and the PDF match analysis.json (no 'growing' for a flat or declining series; scripts/check_claims.ts labelProblems is empty)
